title: On the Dynamics of Multi-Agent LLM Communities Driven by Value Diversity
reasoning: The paper investigates how value diversity (grounded in Schwartz’s Theory of Basic Human Values) shapes the behavior of AI communities. It utilizes a persona elicitation method where agents solve 84 ethical dilemmas (e.g., justice vs. compassion) to discover their values and evaluates the moral/ideological nature of the governance rules they collectively develop.
